services.title: Excavator and earthworks in Almaty
services.intro: Tell us what needs doing and we can discuss excavator work with our operator. Excavators are not offered without our operator; each job needs an individual quote.
services.operator_text: An excavator enquiry includes our operator. The right equipment and whether the work is possible depend on the site and task.
services.jobs_text: A trench, foundation pit or site preparation are useful examples of the information to send. We confirm whether the requested work is possible.
services.access_text: Tell us about the location, preferred date, approximate volume or dimensions, route to the site, ground and any known underground services. Unknown answers are fine.
services.other_text: For tractor or loader work, tell us the task and ask about availability and terms.
services.faq_operator_question: Can I hire an excavator without your operator?
services.faq_operator_answer: No. Excavator work is only available with our operator; we do not provide an excavator without our operator.
services.faq_price_question: Why does the price need an individual quote?
services.faq_price_answer: The quote depends on the job and site conditions. Describe the work and what you know about the location, access and ground; we can discuss the price after clarifying the conditions.
services.faq_unknown_question: Can I request a quote without knowing the volume or dimensions?
services.faq_unknown_answer: Yes. A short job description is enough to start the conversation. Volume and dimensions are optional in the brief, and unknown details can be discussed later. You can also call us directly.
services.faq_whatsapp_question: Does opening WhatsApp send my enquiry?
services.faq_whatsapp_answer: No. Opening WhatsApp or a draft does not send the enquiry. Review the message and press Send in WhatsApp yourself.

quote.title: Request a quote for excavator work in Almaty
quote.intro: Excavators are available only with our operator; hire without our operator is not offered. Each job is quoted individually after the task and site conditions are clarified.
quote.factors_title: Details that help with a quote
quote.factors_text: Tell us what work is needed, where and when, the approximate size, access and ground conditions. You do not need technical measurements to start a conversation.
quote.other_note: For tractor or loader work, tell us the task and ask about availability and terms.
quote.optional_note: Every detail below is optional. You can call or open WhatsApp at any time.

job.label: What work do you need?
job.hint: For example a trench, foundation pit or site preparation; your own words are best.

location.label: Where is the site?
location.hint: Area, address or landmark; the exact address can follow later.
location.unknown: I will confirm the location later

date.label: When would you like to start?
date.hint: Give a preferred date and say whether it is flexible.

volume.label: Approximate volume or dimensions?
volume.hint: m³ or length × width × depth in metres, if known.
volume.unknown: I do not know the volume or dimensions

access.label: Any access restrictions?
access.hint: Gate or path width, turns, height, slope or surface, if known.

conditions.label: Ground and other site conditions?
conditions.hint: Mention known ground conditions or underground services; leave blank if unknown.
conditions.unknown: Site conditions need to be checked

removal.label: Do you want to discuss spoil removal or loading?
removal.hint: Describe what you would like to discuss; feasibility needs confirmation.
